Crypto.com is now authorized to bring single-stock futures to the market, CEO Kris Marszalek said in a post on X.
The company is working with the SEC and the CFTC to offer single-stock perps in the US.
Media reports earlier this month said Robinhood Markets
is expanding its prediction-markets business through a multiyear partnership with Crypto.com, bringing yes-or-no event contracts to its trading app.

title: Crypto.com gets approval for single-stock futures, CEO Kris Marszalek says
